Maya Singh: Heads-up 1 QuantumVista flagged: weekly active tokens down ~47% and active seats slipped 24->9. CRM notes: product lead replaced 2 weeks ago.
Owen Price: hmm. Any timing overlap with a competitor POC?
Maya Singh: customer email says they're trialing NovaML starting last Friday. Drop aligns.
Felix Ortega: infra looks fine, no error uptick. Likely behavior change.
Priya Menon: risk signals = usage decline + new PM + external POC. Suggest immediate triage: 1) 20min sync with new PM, 2) tailored ROI note + common migration FAQ, 3) short demo showing 2 quick wins.
Owen Price: can we get a quick seat-level export and last-21-day token chart? Felix can you run an ad-hoc?
Felix Ortega: SQL IA0use:
```
SELECT date, count(distinct user_id) as active_seats, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE org = 'quantumvista' AND date >= current_date - interval '21 days'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC;
```
Felix Ortega: running now. No P95 latency drift.
oncall-bot: Meeting scheduled: "QuantumVista: PM discovery" on 2026-04-12 09:00 PT 1 invite sent to PM + Maya + Owen + Felix :calendar:
Maya Singh: I'll draft a 3-bullet outreach: 1) short readout of what we observed, 2) ask goals for NovaML POC + blockers, 3) offer a 30-min hands-on session + 30-day seat buffer. Sending in 30m.
Owen Price: I'll prepare a compact pricing move and migration assist offer. Proposal: 30-day seat credit + two migration office-hours.
Priya Menon: I'll put together a 1-slide ROI highlight and 2 product differentiators to call out.
Maya Singh: Action items captured. We'll keep this high-touch until we hear back from the PM.
Owen Price: thumbs up.
Maya Singh: will update after PM reply. (reaction :eyes: 1776543350)
